Our Client, EVI Industries, a publicly traded company and a national leader in the commercial laundry industry, is hiring! We’re seeking a Data Analyst to help improve the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of our data warehouse.

The primary focus of this role is to identify and resolve duplicate, inconsistent, and insufficient data, ensuring our business systems are fueled by clean, trustworthy information. You’ll collaborate with IT, business users, and system owners to design data validation processes, implement cleansing strategies, and support ongoing data governance initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Analyze data across multiple systems to identify duplicates, gaps, and inconsistencies
Cleanse and standardize data in the warehouse to improve overall data quality
Develop rules, workflows, and queries for detecting invalid or incomplete records
Partner with business units to define data quality standards and requirements
Document processes, findings, and recommendations for continuous improvement
Support integration and migration projects by validating and mapping data

What We’re Looking For

2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Steward, or related role
Strong SQL skills for querying and manipulating large datasets
Experience with data cleansing, profiling, and quality tools/processes
Familiarity with relational databases and data warehouse concepts
Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience with Salesforce, Business Central, Sage 100, or Validity
Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, or Synapse
Exposure to data governance frameworks and master data management (MDM)
Background in reporting/BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)

Rea is a growing Top 100 business advisory & accounting firm providing our clients services in tax, accounting, and business consulting. We have a ‘People First’ culture and we focus on our employees’ well-being and professional development. With over 400 professionals and locations throughout Ohio, our firm has a culture that respects a work-life balance for our team. We also provide competitive compensation and a robust benefits plan.

The BI Data Analyst will play a critical role in leveraging Power BI and Azure SQL to analyze data, build data sets, develop insightful reports, and create efficient workflows. The role’s use of these tools will contribute to data-driven decision-making and process optimization across our organization.

Responsibilities

Utilize Power BI to gather and transform data from various sources (IE Excel, APIs, SQL), creating visually appealing and interactive dashboards to present key insights to stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and design meaningful visualizations that drive informed decisions
Design robust generalized SQL datasets through combining raw data for reports.
Work closely with end-users to gather requirements and ensure that dashboards meet their needs effectively
Identify opportunities for reporting and process automation across internal clients and implement solutions that deliver tangible benefits
Apply data cleansing and transformation techniques using Power Query to ensure data accuracy and consistency across different data sources
Collaborate with data warehouse engineers to enhance data quality and resolve data integration issues
Collaborate with team members to share best practices, provide technical guidance, and support the adoption of Power Platform tools
Train end-users on using Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate effectively for their respective needs
Ensure compliance with data governance policies and implement security measures to protect sensitive data within Power Platform solutions
Stay up-to-date with Microsoft's updates and features related to Power Platform to maintain best practices

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Proficiency in data analysis, visualization, and report creation using Power BI
Strong understanding of data transformation, ETL processes, and data modeling concepts
Familiarity with data governance principles and best practices for maintaining data accuracy and security
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into effective Power BI Dashboards or power platform apps.
Problem-solving skills to troubleshoot issues and optimize Power Platform applications
Experience working in a collaborative team environment and a track record of delivering results on time

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field
Proven experience (5+ years) as a Data Analyst, with demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Power Platform tools (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) , intermediate SQL knowledge
Hands-on experience developing custom Power BI Dashboards, analyzing data within SQL databases, building company wide usable datasets
Analyzing raw data and identifying useful metrics and new ways of looking at data to help drive the business
Travel to client locations as needed

Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)

Training & Development

About Us

We are a growing Licensed Home Care Services Agency (LHCSA) dedicated to delivering compassionate, high-quality home care services. We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Data Analyst with a strong understanding of Home Health Aide (HHA) operations and regulatory requirements. This is a key role that supports operational efficiency, compliance, and quality care delivery through data analysis and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze operational, clinical, and financial data to support informed decision-making.
Track HHA staffing, schedules, time logs, and visit verifications.
Monitor compliance with DOH, EVV (Electronic Visit Verification), and LHCSA reporting requirements.
Develop and maintain dashboards to measure key performance indicators (KPIs).
Generate reports for audits, quality assurance, and executive review.
Assist with workforce planning, identifying staffing trends and needs.
Identify data discrepancies and collaborate with relevant departments to correct them.
Support HHA recruitment, retention, and performance tracking through data analytics.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, or related field. (Experience may substitute education.)
Minimum 2 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in a healthcare or LHCSA setting.
Strong understanding of HHA functions, scheduling, and compliance.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
Experience with EVV platforms (e.g., HHAeXchange,) strongly preferred.
Knowledge of NYS DOH regulations for LHCSA operations.
Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with electronic health records (EHRs) or agency management systems.
Understanding of Medicaid billing and reporting.
Bilingual (Bangla, Urdu, or Hindi) a plus.

What We Offer

Competitive salary based on experience
PTO and paid holidays
Career growth opportunities
Supportive and mission-driven team environment

Pay: $20.00 - $28.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40 per week
